description: Search for agentic AI tools by keyword query with optional filters. Use this for keyword-based search. For natural language queries like 'something that automates email', use semantic_search instead. For browsing all tools in a category, use get_category instead.

cohort.description: Filter by cohort: PEOPLE (individual tools) or TEAMS (team/enterprise tools)

mcpSupport.description: Filter to tools with MCP (Model Context Protocol) support

minScore.description: Minimum agenticness score (default 1 to exclude unscored/junk entries, set to 0 to include all)

query.description: Search query (e.g. 'code review', 'open source coding agent')

name: search_listings
